urn.definition:
n. a large vase that usually has a pedestal or feet
n. a large pot for making coffee or tea
urn.translation: n. 瓮, 缸, 坟墓

urn-shaped.definition: s having a concave shape like an urn

urna.translation: (佛教绘画或雕塑中)佛像双眉中间的一束毛发, 或一只慧眼(表示神的洞察力)

urnflower.translation: n. 瓮花草属植物(南美产球茎状植物,开黄绿色坛状花)

urns.definition:
n. a large vase that usually has a pedestal or feet
n. a large pot for making coffee or tea
urns.translation: n. 壶( urn的复数形式 ); 瓮; 缸; 骨灰瓮
